components.name: WorkerBoard

props.name: workers
props.desc: The live roster — one row per running agent (name, status, current issue, owned-issue count).

props.name: onOpen
props.desc: Called with the clicked worker. The host decides what opening means (Fleet swaps in WorkerDetail).

whenUse: A roster of running agents — one row each, with live status and what it is working on.
Any per-agent board where clicking a row hands the agent to a detail surface.
whenNot: A static list with no live status — use CardListRow.
One agent's full detail — that is WorkerDetail, a behavioral host.
components.srcText:
// file-local to features/planner/fleet/Fleet.tsx — not exported yet (extraction is #3462 slice 2)
<WorkerBoard workers={workers} onOpen={openWorker} />

components.name: FleetStatus

props.name: counts
props.desc: Worker count per status — becomes the donut slices, labelled and coloured from the shared STATUS map.

props.name: total
props.desc: Total live workers, shown in the donut centre. 0 renders the empty state instead of an empty ring.

whenUse: A one-glance breakdown of a population by status, with the total in the centre.
Pairing a donut with a colour-keyed legend of the same slices.
whenNot: A time series — use LineArea or Bars.
A single metric with no breakdown — use StatCard.
components.srcText:
// file-local to features/planner/fleet/Fleet.tsx — not exported yet (extraction is #3462 slice 2)
<FleetStatus counts={counts} total={kpis.total} />

components.name: Throughput

props.name: gh
props.desc: The GitHub-derived fleet slice. Reads `throughput` (per-day landed vs merged) and `loading` to pick between skeleton, empty and chart.

whenUse: Two comparable per-day series over a selectable window (7d/14d).
A chart that must distinguish 'still loading' from 'genuinely nothing yet'.
whenNot: A single series — use LineArea directly.
Categorical buckets rather than a date axis — use Bars.

components.name: TimeToLand

props.name: gh
props.desc: The GitHub-derived fleet slice. Reads `timeToLand` (bucketed open→merge durations), `medianLandH` and `loading`.

whenUse: A bucketed duration histogram with a median call-out underneath.
Showing how long a pipeline stage takes across many items.
components.srcText:
// file-local to features/planner/fleet/Fleet.tsx — not exported yet (extraction is #3462 slice 2)
<TimeToLand gh={gh} />

components.name: MergeQueue

props.name: gh
props.desc: The GitHub-derived fleet slice. Reads `mergeQueue` (rows of pr/title/repo/state) and `loading`.

whenUse: A queue of items carrying a colour-coded state (green/running/blocked/draft).
Cross-repo rows where each needs a secondary identifier line.
whenNot: Items with no state axis — use CardListRow.

components.name: WorkerModals

props.name: modal
props.desc: Which modal is open; null renders nothing. The host owns this state.

props.name: worker
props.desc: The worker every modal acts on.

props.name: st
props.desc: Resolved label + colour for the worker's status.

props.name: send
props.desc: Submit the draft. The host writes it to the agent's PTY — this component never touches the session.

props.name: profileId
props.desc: The worker's current profile id, if any.

props.name: setPaneProfile
props.desc: Assign a profile. A store action passed IN as a prop — which is what keeps this component pure.

props.name: flash
props.desc: Surface a transient confirmation to the user.

whenUse: A set of modals over one subject, where the host owns every action and piece of state.
A worked example of the host/tree split: store actions arrive as props, so the view stays pure.
whenNot: A modal that fetches or mutates on its own — that belongs in a host.
